guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest deviations in the digest: latency-90 rose 1640% (z=+328), memory rose 886% (z=+177), CPU rose 649% and disk IO went from 0 to 9.26e9, while every other service is flat (|z|<2). Memory has the second-highest z and is the most likely primary fault, with CPU, disk IO and latency plausibly secondary effects of memory pressure, but the digest cannot rule out a cpu or disk fault. The traces and logs are uninformative, with no error spans and no warning or error lines.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll back the recommendationservice pods and raise their memory limit, then profile the service for a memory leak or unbounded cache. Confirm that memory, latency-90 and disk IO return to baseline afterward.
